targetIdentity.rule: Two target records match only when their native ORD product identifier type is SMILES and their source strings are byte-for-byte equal.
targetIdentity.knownLimitation: Exact source-string equality may under-merge equivalent structures; it is not a canonical chemistry toolkit result.

routeIdentity.rule: The ordered canonical value of every listed field defines a route-fragment identity; missing values stay null.

equivalenceRegimes.question: Are these the same ORD reaction record?
Do these records carry the exact same source product SMILES?
Do reactants, catalyst, base, additive, conditions, workup, and record identity all match?

continuityRule.rule: Physical-batch continuity is represented only when a later ORD input contains a native reaction_id cross-reference. Equal compound identifiers alone produce a derived identifier match, never a physical-batch relation.
